sources.snippet: A standalone, embeddable autonomous coding agent for .NET — built on Microsoft.Extensions.AI. SharpCoder gives any IChatClient (OpenAI, Ollama, Azure, Anthropic, etc.) the ability to read files, write code, search codebases, and execute shell commands autonomously. Plug it into your app with a few lines of code.

sources.title: prithivMLmods/Viper-Coder-v0.1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Viper-Coder-v0.1 is based on the Qwen 2.5 14B modality architecture, designed to enhance the reasoning capabilities of 14B-parameter models. It has been fine-tuned on a synthetic dataset based on the latest coding logits and CoT datasets, further optimizing its chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and logical problem-solving abilities.
